job_summary.role_objective: Criar pipelines de dados em tempo real e em batch para processar documentos comerciais, transações financeiras e eventos logísticos.

required_qualifications.experience_description: 4+ anos de experiência em engenharia ou arquitetura de dados, idealmente nos setores de finanças, comércio internacional ou logística.
required_qualifications.education_requirements: Formação superior em Tecnologias de Informação, Cibersegurança, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas semelhantes;

preferred_qualifications.other_notes: Português/Espanhol (desejável)

key_responsibilities: Criar pipelines de dados em tempo real e em batch para processar documentos comerciais, transações financeiras e eventos logísticos.

Implementar governança de dados, verificações de qualidade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
Colaborar com equipes de finanças, risco, operações e TI para entender as necessidades e entregar soluções escaláveis.

job_summary.role_objective: transformar os seus negócios por meio da tecnologia para melhorar os seus processos e resultados.

required_qualifications.experience_description: Entre 1 e 8 anos de experiência em Data Engineering
required_qualifications.education_requirements: Licenciatura ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática ou áreas relacionadas, ou experiência equivalente em Data Engineering.
soft_skills_keywords: Proatividade na identificação e resolução de desafios técnicos

preferred_qualifications.other_notes:
Paixão por aprender e aplicar
novas tecnologias.

key_responsibilities: Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) eficientes e escaláveis.
Trabalhar com equipas multidisciplinares para entender os requisitos de dados e transformá-los em soluções técnicas.
Garantir a qualidade, integridade e fiabilidade dos dados em toda a pipeline.
Escrever queries SQL eficientes e realizar modelação de dados relacional e dimensional.
Implementar boas práticas de CI/CD no ciclo de vida dos dados, com foco em automação e integração contínua.
Participar na modelação de bases de dados e arquitetura de soluções orientadas a dados.
Contribuir para a evolução da stack tecnológica, trazendo sugestões e novas ferramentas para o ecossistema de dados.
Colaborar em projetos com foco na cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), integrando e gerindo serviços de dados cloud-native.
Trabalhar em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando em cerimónias de planeamento, reviews e retrospectivas.
Comunicar com clareza com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de dados.
Demonstrar proatividade na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos complexos

job_summary.role_objective: Your mission is to guide prospective customers toward adopting SoSafe’s cybersecurity awareness platform by delivering impactful, tailored demonstrations that showcase its business value.

required_qualifications.experience_description: Experience in presales, sales engineering, or technical consulting

preferred_qualifications.other_notes: French or Spanish fluency is a bonus

key_responsibilities: demonstrating the business and technical value of SoSafe’s cybersecurity awareness platform
Drive technical discovery sessions, identifying customer problems and ensuring a tailored approach to demonstrating SoSafe’s solutions.
Deliver compelling, outcome-driven demos that highlight key features, such as behavioral-driven security awareness training, risk analytics, and phishing simulation impact.

Provide guidance on technical integrations, including Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML/OAuth, Entra ID (SCIM) user provisioning, Learning Management System (LMS) content integrations (SCORM/xAPI), and API-based reporting/data exports to security dashboards (SIEMs).
Advise customers on best practices for implementing phishing simulations and human risk assessments to maximize security awareness program effectiveness.
Assist proof-of-concept (POC) evaluations and pilot implementations, addressing customer security, compliance, and scalability concerns.
Address security questionnaires and RFPs, collaborating with internal teams to ensure accurate and competitive feedback.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to provide market feedback, contribute to technical enablement, and refine demo narratives.
Establish yourself as a trusted cybersecurity advisor, helping organizations reduce human risk and strengthen their security culture through effective awareness programs.

job_summary.role_objective: The IT Service Desk Engineer will be the main point of contact for all IT-related issues and requests. This role ensures that incidents and service requests are handled efficiently, either by resolving them directly or bringing up them appropriately. The goal is to deliver high-quality support and maintain customer satisfaction through a single point of service.

required_qualifications.experience_description: Minimum 2 years of experience in IT service desk or Level 1 support roles.
required_qualifications.education_requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

preferred_qualifications.other_notes: ITIL Certification (highly desirable)

key_responsibilities: Act as the main point of contact for all IT-related inquiries, incidents, and service requests.
Log, prioritize, and assign incidents and requests using the ticketing system.
Provide Level 1 support for all IT issues, ensuring prompt resolution of common technical problems.
Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution in line with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Communicate incident status updates to users in a clear and concise manner.
Bring up complex issues to Level 2 or specialized support teams while ensuring effective communication.
Liaise with other IT teams to provide a seamless support experience for end-users.
Track critical issues to ensure a prompt and appropriate response.
Assist end-users in using collaboration tools, applications, and IT systems effectively.
Provide basic training or information sessions on frequently used tools and processes.
Develop user-friendly guides and documentation for common support topics.
Identify recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions to reduce incident volumes.
Contribute to the knowledge base by documenting troubleshooting steps for common issues.
Participate in regular team meetings to review incident trends and share best practices.

job_summary.role_objective: Develop and implement machine learning models tailored to CRM and platform contexts.

required_qualifications.experience_description: Proven experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, with a focus on CRM and platform-based solutions.
required_qualifications.education_requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

preferred_qualifications.other_notes:
Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools is a plus.
Experience with CRM platforms and customer data analytics is an advantage.

key_responsibilities: Develop and implement machine learning models tailored to CRM and platform contexts.
Design and deploy models for retention use cases, anomaly detection, regression analysis, and other predictive analytics tasks.
Create and manage automated data pipelines for efficient data processing and model deployment.
Ensure seamless integration of machine learning models into existing systems and workflows.
Monitor data flows to ensure the quality, consistency, and reliability of data used for machine learning models.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues promptly to maintain smooth operations.
Utilize Azure Databricks for data processing, model training, and deployment.
Optimize the use of Databricks resources to achieve efficient and cost-effective machine learning solutions.
Design and maintain the infrastructure required for machine learning projects, ensuring scalability and performance.
Collaborate with IT and DevOps teams to manage cloud resources and deployment environments.

benefits.training_development: Continuous professional development sponsored by our Training and Certification Department;

job_summary.role_objective: Design, implement, and manage data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure, including data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts.

required_qualifications.experience_description: Proven experience as a Data Engineer or similar role, with a focus on Azure cloud platform.
required_qualifications.education_requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

preferred_qualifications.other_notes: Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer Associate) are a plus.

key_responsibilities: Design, implement, and manage data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure, including data lakes, data warehouses, and data marts.
Develop efficient data models and schemas for optimal storage and retrieval.
Build scalable ETL pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, or SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) to ingest data from various sources into Azure.
Ensure data transformation and cleansing processes align with business requirements.
Deploy and manage Azure data storage solutions such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure SQL Database.
Optimize data storage and retrieval performance, ensuring security and compliance.
Utilize Azure Synapse Analytics (formerly Azure SQL Data Warehouse) and Azure Databricks for big data processing and analytics tasks.
Perform data aggregation, enrichment, and analysis to support business intelligence and reporting needs.
Monitor data pipelines and storage solutions for performance bottlenecks and optimize for scalability and cost-effectiveness.
Troubleshoot data-related issues and ensure data quality and integrity.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Document data architecture, processes, and workflows for knowledge sharing and future reference.
